Metadata.GlobalAvailability: Available for dermatologists to sign up and use clinically [SOURCE 4]
Metadata.Summary: DermGPT is an AI chatbot designed to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and help dermatologists save time by providing relevant, helpful answers from trusted, physician-approved sources based on over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles. [SOURCE 4, 5]
Metadata.Keywords: AI; dermatology; chatbot; clinical efficiency; prior authorizations; patient education; psoriasis; eczema

UsesAndDirections.IntendedUseAndWorkflow: DermGPT is intended to provide quick access to dermatology information, aid in patient management through educational handouts, assist with prior authorizations and denial letters, help residents study for boards, and answer patient inquiries. [SOURCE 4, 5]
UsesAndDirections.PrimaryIntendedUsers: Dermatologists, dermatology residents, nurses, medical assistants, and ancillary staff are the primary intended users of DermGPT. [SOURCE 4, 5]
UsesAndDirections.NecessaryKnowledgeExpertise: Users need a basic understanding of dermatology and clinical practice. DermGPT is intended as an assistant and should not replace medical decision-making. [SOURCE 5]
UsesAndDirections.HowToUse: Dermatologists can sign up at dermgpt.com to use the AI chatbot for free. It can be used to look up diagnoses, treatments, prior authorization criteria, and create patient handouts. [SOURCE 4, 5]
UsesAndDirections.TargetedPatientPopulation: DermGPT is intended to improve care for dermatology patients by assisting physicians and staff in providing more efficient and informed care. [SOURCE 5]

Warnings.DeveloperSuppliedWarnings: DermGPT does not replace medical care or decision-making; it should be used as an assistant. [SOURCE 5]
Warnings.ModelLimitations: DermGPT is not a human and lacks creativity, intuition, and the ability to think outside the box. It should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker but as an assistant to dermatologists and their staff to save time and improve access to dermatologic data. [SOURCE 5]

TrustIngredients.AISystemFacts: DermGPT is an AI chatbot built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles, designed to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and save time for physicians. It provides specific and reliable answers to dermatology-related questions [SOURCE 4, 5].
TrustIngredients.ModelType: AI-powered dermatology chatbot that uses a proprietary database of trusted, physician-approved sources to provide relevant and helpful answers to dermatologists' questions. [SOURCE 5]
TrustIngredients.InteractionWithOtherSystems: DermGPT can integrate with existing EHR systems to streamline documentation and facilitate seamless information exchange. [SOURCE 5]
TrustIngredients.OutcomesAndOutput: DermGPT provides healthcare providers with quick references for medication options, dosing, and interactions; summarizes diagnosis and treatment guidelines for complex cases; suggests appropriate labs, imaging, and procedures for diagnostic workups; automates documentation such as visit notes, orders, and prescriptions; answers questions about diagnoses; writes insurance authorization letters; creates patient handouts regarding drugs, after-care, and more; summarizes a provider’s medical notes; assists with study guides for Board Exams; and provides informed consent language regarding procedures and telehealth consults. [SOURCE 5]
TrustIngredients.TypeAndValueOfSolutionOutput: DermGPT provides quick and easily accessible high-quality data, patient education, research, and data analysis. [SOURCE 5]
TrustIngredients.ExplanationForHowAnOutputIsGenerated: DermGPT pulls information from a proprietary database of trusted, physician-approved sources rather than a generic language model. [SOURCE 5]
TrustIngredients.OutputInputDataType: Natural language queries as input, and relevant, helpful answers as output, similar to a real-life colleague [SOURCE 5].
TrustIngredients.DevelopmentDataCharacterization: Proprietary database of trusted, physician-approved sources. [SOURCE 5]
TrustIngredients.TrainingData: Trained on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.ExclusionInclusionCriteria: Pulls from trusted, physician-approved sources; does not use information that may not be scientifically sound or sourced from peer-reviewed medical journals [SOURCE 5].
TrustIngredients.OngoingMaintenance: DermGPT is continuously updated and improved [SOURCE 5].
TrustIngredients.TransparencyInformation: DermGPT only pulls from trusted, physician-approved sources [SOURCE 5].

UsefulnessEfficacy.GoalOfMetrics: DermGPT aims to improve patient care and streamline dermatology practices by assisting with clinical tasks and making dermatology information readily available. It can also leverage machine learning to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and accessibility in dermatology.
UsefulnessEfficacy.Interpretation: Minutes saved in a day because of DermGPT will yield more efficient patient care, decreased wait times to see a dermatologist, and less physician burnout.

SafetyReliability.GoalOfMetrics: The goal of DermGPT is to improve patient care and streamline dermatology practices by assisting with clinical tasks and making dermatology information readily available. [SOURCE 5]
SafetyReliability.Result: DermGPT is built on a proprietary database of trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals. This ensures the information is scientifically sound and reliable, minimizing errors and hallucinations that can occur with general language models like ChatGPT. [SOURCE 5, 4]
SafetyReliability.Interpretation: DermGPT is designed to be a timesaving enterprise chatbot, an AI-powered dermatological colleague trained with chat, reasoning, and writing abilities, customized with a highly expert-curated dermatology-specific database. It lacks human creativity and intuition and is most powerful when paired with a dermatology provider or staff. [SOURCE 5]
SafetyReliability.TestingDataDescription: DermGPT is trained on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles. [SOURCE 4]
SafetyReliability.ValidationProcessAndJustification: DermGPT is continuously updated and improved, ensuring it remains the most up-to-date source of material. [SOURCE 5]

Resources.StakeholdersConsultedDuringDesignOfSolut: DermGPT is designed to remove barriers for patients and physicians alike. [SOURCE 3]
